overallObservation: The independent review failed only the fabricated evidence ledger. It explicitly passed the UI, browser, visual and dependency corrections listed below.

approvedObservations.observation: The reviewer visually inspected and approved all eleven enforced PNG baselines, including the open menu, visible focus and API-unavailable composition.
The reviewer approved the real-Chromium 44 by 44 CSS pixel target evidence across all twelve Q1 viewport probes.
The reviewer approved the exact open home, navigate to cart, browser Back to home regression with the disclosure remaining closed.
The reviewer approved the named storefront banner evidence in connected and unavailable API modes.
The reviewer approved the closed and open shell Axe results in the connected and unavailable browser runs.
The reviewer approved the Q1 viewport overflow results from the connected and unavailable browser runs.
The reviewer approved the reduced-motion browser result for automatic scrolling and zero-duration shell transitions.
The reviewer independently proved that a temporary visual mismatch fails without updating tracked baselines.

correctionObservations.observation: At 360 by 800 in real Chromium, Tab reached the menu trigger, Enter opened it, Tab reached Products, and Escape closed it with focus returned to the trigger.
At 1023 by 900 the disclosure was visibly expanded; resizing to 1024 by 900 removed the trigger and exposed the desktop Storefront navigation without stale expanded state.
At the Q1 320 by 800 reflow viewport, the unavailable page remained readable without horizontal clipping and exposed the explicit text status API unavailable rather than relying on color alone.

remainingObservations.observation: The correction inspected the Q1 320 pixel reflow equivalent but did not separately operate the browser's native zoom control at 400 percent.
